purpose: host whole-entry sentence-by-sentence precheck of long lore entries before the first EXECUTOR dispatch (window 28 lesson)
method: a read-only helper compared the eight long entries paragraph by paragraph; the host verified every quoted English and Chinese phrase exists in the frozen workset and accepted each item on its merits

items: P4 We figured we would have a celebration for everyone → 我们想着为大家办一场庆祝会（非“我们以为大家都会庆祝一下”）
P4 补译叙述句 Finishing the first sentence the ogre looked at me, as if to add one important addition to it 与 from what I have heard；第一句引语在“忘却一切”后收住，另起引语
P4 I had barely clued in that I was receiving anything more than gratitude → 我几乎没意识到战略家带来的不只是感谢（非“只希望得到感谢”）
P5 have another incident like with that enchantress → 会不会再发生像那位女附魔师那样的事（非“在那个女巫的身上，你遇到了同样的事情”）
P5 It would probably be better if I stayed away → 保留 probably（“或许还是离远些为好”）
P6 My words perhaps hit me the hardest → 保留 perhaps 与 the hardest
P6 seemingly connecting with my thoughts as perfectly as they did → 那几个字仿佛与我的心思完全契合（非“和我的思想一样完美”）
P7 dragged … to wherever the festivities were → 拖向庆典举办的地方（非“节日的各个地方”）
P7 happier … than I had been in a long while → 很久以来未曾有过的快乐（非“比很久以前更快乐”）
P8 a group of a dozen ogres → 补“十来个”；smiles cracking from a few of their faces → 补“其中几个人”
P1 I believe he may have been → 保留 may（删“极大程度上”）
P3 the dwarves likely would have kept it a secret → 原本很可能会一直保守秘密（反事实，非现状）
P3 the blasted mages caused their home to collapse in on them → 那些该死的法师让他们的家园在头顶坍塌（blasted 为咒骂语，非“爆炸”）
P4 删增译“今早”
P6 a couple of halflings / The halflings → 两个半身人（删两处增译“夫妇”）
P9 possibly ones that required secrecy → 保留 possibly
Maj'Eyal 按 preferred 术语统一为“马基·埃亚尔”（本条现作“马基埃亚尔”）
P3 a dozen more or so → 十来个人（非“若干”）；motioned to another of the guards → 示意另一名士兵（非“其他士兵都”）
P5 likely to settlements they had been forced to come from → 保留 likely，settlements 为定居点
P7 some conversed … while others gambled 指酒馆里的客人（删“难民们”）
P8 I was thinking of doing the same anyway → 反正我本来也打算这么干（非假设句）
P1 perhaps the most unusual → 保留 perhaps
P2 wiry and unkempt patches of hair → 一簇簇粗硬凌乱、疏密不一的毛发（非“蓬松”）
P2 The mental faculties of thinking Drem → 保留 thinking 限定
P2 even as it tried to explain it to you → 它试着向你解释（与下句“它的警告”一致，单数）
P2 Something is coming → 有什么东西要来了（不定指）
